 Cook’s AAA on FOX Review 11.7.26   
 Hey kids! Steve Cook here with you for the latest episode of AAA on Mexico’s FOX & the United States’ YouTube! It’s Week 3 of Heroes Immortals, and we’ve got two big matches scheduled along with the induction of Marisela Pena into the AAA Hall of Fame. I’m sure Marisela’s induction will go off without incident and nobody will try to start any drama.
 Don’t forget to subscribe to the 411Mania Wrestling Newsletter! Click here to do so , and then every Tuesday you’ll get some exclusive insight from your humble Chef on everything you need to know about the latest and greatest pro wrestling happenings! I guarantee it’ll be a good time, so make sure you check it out.
 Cook’s Lucha Libre AAA Review 11.7.26 
 Then. Now. Forever. Together! 
 The third edition of the Heroes Immortals opening victory asks what we’re willing to become and goes over the events for tonight. 
 We’re still in Mexico City! Rey Mysterio HELPS MARISELA PENA OUT OF THE CAR! Dorian Roldan is WALKING! El Fiscal is WALKING! Abismo Negro Jr. is WALKING! Corey Graves, JBL & Rey Mysterio are our hosts. 
 Bravo Americano (w/Rayo Americano) vs. Cruz del Toro (w/Joaquin Wilde) vs. Kento (w/Takuma) : Bravo atomic drops Cruz & Kento, then jabs them. Cruz knocked down. Bravo & Kento match wits, Cruz knocks Bravo off the apron. Kick by Cruz, Bravo yanks him outside and they punch away at each other until Kento dives onto them. We go to commercial!
 Cru & Kento trade shots and clothesline each other down. Bravo crossbodies each from the top while wearing a hat. After sending them outside he hits a tope suicida. Cruz is airplane spun and then dropped for a two count. Kento with a superkick, goes up top and slips but headbutts Bravo for two. Then Kento tries to suplex Bravo over the top rope, Bravo falls but Kento can’t make the flip. Kinda awkward stretch. Cruz with a tornillo on the floor. He puts Bravo in the tree of woe, sends Kento into him and goes up top to hit the coast to coast! Cruz covers Kento & Bravo for two. Cruz punches away on Bravo. Bravo with strikes to both opponents, then he explodes Cruz into Kento! Bravo lifts Cruz, Cruz gets it into a sleeper, but then Bravo ends up suplexing both of them! The partners get involved, Rayo dives onto the Bad Boys. Cruz with a big kick on Bravo, Wilde sprays him accidentally! Bravo hits a headbutt off the ropes, then goes up top for a splash and a three count!
 Winner: Bravo Americano (7:23 shown via pinfall) 
 Match Rating: **1/2 
 Some rough stretches, it seemed like some folks got tired during the end there. That happens sometimes in that high altitude. Knowing how WWE in general feels about tag team wrestling, it probably behooves all these guys to do well with the opportunities they’re given. 
 Pimpinela Escarlata talks about their recent reality show they appeared in, and tells Omos that no one will mess with Pimpi. Pimpi’s been forty years. Pimpi was a street fighter and know where they come from. Pimpi challenges Omos, which sounds like a terrible idea on several fronts. 
 El Fiscal vs. Abismo Negro Jr. : Fiscal & Abismo fire away at each other. Fiscal tosses his jacket at Abismo and punches away. Clothesline by Abismo. Abismo takes control and chokes Fiscal on the ropes. Both clothesline each other when Abismo charges into the corner. Backbreaker by Fiscal, who then gets tossed to the floor. Abismo follows him out and clotheslines him from behind. Fiscal gets his head bounced off the announce desk. Abismo says it’s his name & his mask. Back in the ring, Abismo drops Fiscal for a near fall, then he starts stretching Fiscal on the mat. They eventually break, Abismo goes for a suplex, Fiscal blocks and lifts Abismo for the suplex. Clotheslines by Fiscal. Fiscal with a twisting crossbody for two. Fiscal with a tope suicida while JBL talks about his potential & greenness. We go to commercial!
 Fiscal goes for a musclebuster, it ends up being a slam for a two count. Fiscal sends Abismo into the steps. Fiscal holds the steps up and tosses them down before lowering his straps and setting Abismo up for a Martinete on the steps! Abismo blocks and hits Fiscal with the steps! The referee rings the bell!
 Winner: Nobody (7:08 shown via no contest) 
 Match Rating: **1/4 
 This was one of the lesser Fiscal/Abismo matches we’ve seen on this show. 
 Abismo sends Fiscal’s neck with a chair against it into the steps, hits him with a chair several times after security guards fail to break it up. They finally shoo him up the entranceway after a couple of failures. 
 Fiscal, Money Machine & El Grande Americano congratulate and thank Marisela Pena.
 Jesus Zungia introduces Marisela Pena, then throws us to a video package covering her time with the company. A vision changed lucha libre forever, and when someone else had to carry it on, Marisela did. She has strengthened Antonio’s legacy and has taken AAA further than ever before. She shaped the history of AAA for three decades. After the video ends, Jesus introduces Rey Mysterio to do the induction. I feel like they do this differently at other Hall of Fame ceremonies, but AAA can be different. 
 Rey tells us that when he was a kid the only thing he wanted was an opportunity. Antonio Pena gave him that opportunity. Pena had a dream for lucha to be seen not just in Mexico, but around the world. People wondered what would happen to that dream. Marisela protected it and is the classiest person. She also fought for the talent & company and never backed down. She brought AAA & WWE together. Some said it was a risk, Marisela saw it as the opportunity to make her brother’s dream come true. AAA will go on for a long time. They’re on the biggest stage in the world in front of fans that might not have seen it before. It’s the fulfillment of Antonio’s dream by his sister, Marisela. The Pena family gave Rey a career and a home. Marisela has opened the door to the next generation of the world. Rey thanks her for her heart, class & loyalty to lucha libre. Rey introduces Marisela as the new inductee into the AAA Hall of Fame.
 Marisela thanks the fans for the love. She just wants to say that her brother left AAA with them, but before she can go too far here comes Dorian Roldan! JBL is very touched by this interruption by Dorian while Corey is disgusted. Dorian asks for forgiveness from Marisela for interrupting this special moment. There’s something to attend to. The fans don’t want to hear it, but Dorian insists there’s news that can’t wait. He’s got a letter from the commission! Dorian presented a formal complaint against Rey’s actions at TripleMania. There were three complaints. Rey sent wrestlers to the US and subjected them to horrible working conditions. Hijo del Vikingo was injured there, and so was Mini Vikingo. Rey attacked a fan that had come to the event. Rey points out it was Omos, but Dorian points out that Rey attacked him. Rey abused his power as General Manager at Triplemania when he made the three count, and when he intervened in the rematch. The commission has indefinitely suspended Rey Mysterio from his duties of general manager! 
 Dorian has more, there’s something even more personal. Rey is always in constant need of power. It wasn’t enough for Rey to control the locker room, the office and Dorian’s family business. Dorian asked why Marisela made Rey the GM instead of him, and let Rey induct her into the Hall of Fame. Dorian has real proof that Rey, in an attempt to gain power in the company, is having an extramarital affair with Marisela! Rey & Marisela both seem stunned while Dorian shakes his head in disgust. Rey & Marisela talk while Dorian exits the ring and our event comes to an end. So long for now!
 Listen, this sort of thing might actually get over with the crowd. Mexican fans love their telenovelas. It’s really not my cup of tea and doesn’t seem to accomplish much other than extending things with Rey, Dorian, Marisela and whoever else gets involved. Does Dom try to steal Marisela? 
 If you’d like to chime in with your own thoughts on tonight’s show, feel free to join your fellow 411 Maniacs down in the comment section! As the legendary Larry Csonka always said: Have fun and don’t be a dick. When I’m not here you can catch me on social media from time to time. To be honest, e-mail is a better option and you can reach me at [email protected] . 
 5.0

Maybe it catches on with the crowd, but I can't say I have high hopes. I do have high hopes for next week, see you then!
